context: The review stamp is a content hash, so whatever a wireframe is must be hashable from the fresh clone rcf verify run works in. A Figma or Confluence link cannot be hashed and drifts silently. The HQ ux-designer role produced 24 standalone HTML wireframes this week; the application-spa blueprint ships markdown wireframes whose section headings are inconsistent (half carry Shape, half States, none all three). The verdict (Q4) ruled: markdown, self-contained HTML, PNG for as-built migration only; hash bytes, never headings.
decision: A wireframe is a file under rcf/discovery/wireframes/<screen-slug>.md, .html or .png. Markdown is the default. HTML is accepted only when self-contained: any href, src or srcset attribute value, and any CSS url() or @import target in a style element or a style attribute, that starts http:, https: or // (a stylesheet, script, image or font fetched from outside the pack) fails discovery:wireframeSelfContained naming the file and the first offending URL. PNG is accepted only on a record declared as-built (rcf discover journey declare --as-built), so a capture of an existing screen can serve a product that declares after the fact; a .png on any other record, and any extension outside .md, .html and .png, fails discovery:wireframeFormat naming the file and the rule. The check hashes the bytes of every wireframe file with sha256 and never parses headings or sections; a heading-structure check is explicitly not a check. Links go on Screen.references for the mid-fi layer and never satisfy any check.
consequences: The 24 standalone HTML files pass the byte-hash rule unchanged. A product can switch a wireframe from markdown to HTML without touching the record. An HTML file that pulls a CDN font, whether through a link tag or an @import in its style block, is refused until inlined, which is the cost of a reproducible hash in an offline clone. A new product cannot ship screenshots as its lo-fi wireframes: PNG is the migration format and nothing else. No format conversion, no renderer and no dependency is added.

alternativesConsidered.name: Links as wireframes
alternativesConsidered.summary: Accept a Figma or Confluence URL on the screen as the wireframe.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: Not hashable, drifts silently, unreachable from a fresh clone; the review stamp would seal nothing.

alternativesConsidered.name: Markdown-only with a heading-structure check
alternativesConsidered.summary: Require Shape, States and Behaviour sections and fail on a missing one.
alternativesConsidered.reasonNotChosen: The shipped blueprint wireframes already disagree on headings; the check would refuse the method's own examples and recreate the edge-case world the product owner ruled out.

title: Wireframes are files in the pack: markdown default, self-contained HTML, PNG for migration; hashed as bytes, never inspected for headings
